config.description: Recover explicit Zigbee2MQTT set failures for static scheduled fixtures. Coalesce errors and retry one fixture per five-second tick, using its latest lighting plan. At most three retries per fixture per five-minute episode; persistent failure produces a notification. Off/unavailable fixtures and active animations are excluded. Bridge outages retain pending work.

triggers.value_template: {{ 'failed' if value_json is defined and value_json is mapping and value_json.get('level')=='error' and value_json.get('message','') | regex_findall("^(?:z2m: )?Publish 'set' '(?:color_temp|color|brightness|state)' to '([^']+)' failed:") | count > 0 else 'ignored' }}

data.title: Lighting Command Could Not Be Delivered
data.message: {{ repeat.item }} still reported Zigbee command failures after three recovery attempts. Automatic retries for this fixture are paused for the rest of this five-minute episode. Check its power and Zigbee connection.
